note: Canonical provenance for the bundled learned models. source_url is the update feed when one exists (a small JSON serving {version, sha256}); empty means the model is produced locally by produced_by and has no remote feed. The manifest falls back to these fields when a per-model sidecar omits them.

ai_detector.description: Binary AI-generated-music detector (logistic head on librosa features).
ai_detector.license: internal weights; SONICS training data CC-BY-NC-4.0 (research/eval only); MTG-Jamendo Apache-2.0 distribution of Creative-Commons-sourced audio

ai_attribution.description: Closed-set per-service acoustic attribution model for AI-generated audio.
ai_attribution.license: internal weights; SONICS training data CC-BY-NC-4.0 (research/eval only)

artifact_model.description: Multi-label forensic artifact classifier (RVQ ghosting, codec residue, HF aliasing, hollow compression).
artifact_model.provenance: real audio (MUSDB18 + MTG-Jamendo) with real artifact injection: EnCodec RVQ round trip, real ffmpeg transcode, real bad-resample aliasing, real pedalboard compression/EQ
artifact_model.license: internal weights; MUSDB18 non-commercial, MTG-Jamendo Apache-2.0 distribution of Creative-Commons-sourced audio

mood_tagger.description: Multi-label mood/theme classifier (per-tag logistic regression on named DSP features) - additional evidence alongside mood_energy.py's heuristic, not a replacement.
mood_tagger.provenance: MTG-Jamendo official mood/theme tags (uploader-supplied, not expert-reviewed)
mood_tagger.license: internal weights; MTG-Jamendo audio is Creative-Commons-sourced, Apache-2.0 distribution

mix_quality.description: Self-supervised known-mix-defect classifier; not a subjective quality verdict.
mix_quality.provenance: MUSDB18 + MTG-Jamendo audio with deterministic programmatic degradations
mix_quality.license: internal weights; MUSDB18 non-commercial, MTG-Jamendo Creative-Commons-sourced audio

key_tempo.description: Optional key/tempo ONNX model (onnx_inference.py); not shipped - the chroma/librosa estimators are used when absent.

vocal_pitch.description: Monophonic vocal pitch (CREPE-tiny, 360 bins of 20 cents) for pitch accuracy, the pitch editor and monophonic MIDI (NEW-7); pyin when absent.
vocal_pitch.produced_by: python scripts/export_crepe_onnx.py (weights from the torchcrepe 0.0.24 wheel)
vocal_pitch.provenance: CREPE, Kim, Salamon, Li & Bello 2018; trained by its authors on MIR-1K, Bach10, RWC-Synth, MedleyDB, MDB-STEM-Synth and NSynth

beat_tracker.description: Beat and downbeat activations (Beat This! small0) for bar lines in song structure (NEW-6); the librosa tracker and meter estimate when absent.
beat_tracker.produced_by: python scripts/export_beat_this_onnx.py --checkpoint small0.ckpt (beat_this 1.1.0 + rotary-embedding-torch on PYTHONPATH)
beat_tracker.provenance: Beat This!, Foscarin, Schlueter & Widmer, ISMIR 2024; checkpoint small0 from the authors

clap_mood_probe.description: Whole-track mood/theme tags (13 MTG-Jamendo tags): logistic heads on the CLAP track embedding (learned/clap_probes.py, NEW-9). Experimental; shown beside the emotional arc.
clap_mood_probe.produced_by: python scripts/train_clap_probes.py embed-mood && python scripts/train_clap_probes.py fit-mood
clap_mood_probe.provenance: MTG-Jamendo official mood/theme tags (uploader-supplied), the feature tagger's own train / validation split
clap_mood_probe.license: internal weights; MTG-Jamendo audio is Creative-Commons-sourced, Apache-2.0 distribution

clap_ai_probe.description: AI-generation likelihood: one logistic head on the CLAP track embedding (learned/clap_probes.py, NEW-9). Experimental evidence beside the AI Detection verdict, never in it.
clap_ai_probe.produced_by: python scripts/train_clap_probes.py embed-ai && python scripts/train_clap_probes.py fit-ai
clap_ai_probe.provenance: SONICS generated songs (Suno, Udio; CC-BY-NC-4.0) vs MTG-Jamendo tracks, both cut and MP3 round-tripped alike
clap_ai_probe.license: internal weights; SONICS CC-BY-NC-4.0 (research / non-commercial), MTG-Jamendo Apache-2.0 distribution
